name: navios-memory-reflex
description: Local-first prompt memory retrieval and compaction recovery for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve durable local memory and recover after compaction.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex memory layer that turns project notes into provenance-addressed cells, expands retrieval through typed graph edges, and restores a frozen authoritative checkpoint after context compaction.
defaultPrompt: Initialize durable memory for this project
Retrieve relevant memory with exact provenance
Show the current compaction recovery checkpoint
